examples.english: You can apply for this job without qualifications, but experienced applicants are given priority.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without) + ⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧ (qualification/license). Used to describe lacking the formal credentials, certifications, or legal authorization required for an activity or profession.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無資格|むしかく}{者|しゃ}: unqualified person
- {無資格|むしかく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work without qualifications
- {無資格|むしかく}⟦{診療|しんりょう}→診療：14183_shinryou⟧: unlicensed medical practice
- {無資格|むしかく}⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧: driving without a license

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {無免許|むめんきょ}: unlicensed (specifically lacking a formal license/permit, especially for driving)
- ⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧なし: without qualifications (informal phrasing)
- ⟦{不適格|ふてきかく}→不適格：24253_futekikaku⟧: disqualified, unfit (implies being judged unsuitable, not merely lacking credentials)
